capability.summary: Search arXiv preprints by an all-fields query
capability.description: Queries arXiv's Atom feed endpoint with a fixed all:<query> search and optional max-results value. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Academic preprint discovery by arXiv all-fields query; not full-text retrieval, peer-review validation, or general scholarly database search.

constraint.io_signature: Input: query string and optional max_results string; output: JSON wrapper envelope with arXiv http_status and feed or HTTP error body. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional numeric max-results string; wrapper default is 3
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET http://export.arxiv.org/api/query with search_query=all:<query> and max_results=<value>; no field-specific query syntax exposed
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
wrapper does not parse Atom entries or truncate the response; the API controls feed content and result count
no auth, cache, or retry; shared helper uses a 25-second timeout and external results can change

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing the arXiv feed body with requested URL and HTTP status.

intent_tags: find academic papers by all-fields query
negative_intents: download or summarize full paper PDFs
search clinical trials or general web pages

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing the arXiv feed body with requested URL and HTTP status.
